Lina (Growth): quick huddle: final copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. goal: launch post + webinar CTA + inbound routing. who can take hero variants? :sparkles:
Theo (Content): I9ll write two hero variants per mode: one technical, one value-led. example Hosted hero: "Production-ready inference, no ops overhead." alternative: "Build fast with low-latency, pay-as-you-go inference."
Iris (Design): keep hero short (6-9 words). subhead 10-18 words. we should include a tiny benchmark pill under hero (p95, throughput, cost proxy).
Omar (PM): standardize CTAs: Primary = Try / Demo (contextual), Secondary = Read benchmarks or Join webinar. Webinar CTA should appear on Hosted and Dedicated headers; Private uses enterprise contact form.
Renee (Analytics): routing plan: CTA + org_size field. mapping: Hosted -> hosted-list, Dedicated -> dedicated-list, Private -> sales-queue with priority. webinar -> webinar pipeline. add utm_campaign=launch_post.
Theo (Content): webinar blurb draft: "Join a live walkthrough: benchmarks, migration paths, and Q&A." add line on cost vs latency.
Iris (Design): will mock hero A/Bs in Figma and componentize benchmark pill.
Lina (Growth): product note: add single line highlighting migration path: "Start on Hosted, scale to Dedicated, secure with Private 14 same API." keep unified-runtime message.
Theo (Content): pushing copy to doc: https://docs.google.com/tri-mode-copy 14 comment away.
StagingBot: staging build updated: /staging/tri-mode-landing preview https://staging.redwood.ai/tri-mode-landing
Omar (PM): QA checklist: links, forms, utm, event tracking, benchmark numbers verified, webinar registration. ownership: Lina signs copy, Omar signs routing/tracking, Iris signs layout.
Renee (Analytics): added conditional routing: org_size >= 500 -> sales-high, else -> nurture. creating HubSpot mapping ticket.
Theo (Content): adding one enterprise line for Dedicated/Private variants and speaker blurbs for webinar.
Lina (Growth): timeline: copy EOD, mocks noon tomorrow, staging push tomorrow afternoon, soft launch email + one launch post day after. thanks team :thumbsup:
